Journal_Exp81.summary: Main story cutscene in Spring Meadows; unmissable.

Journal_Exp68.summary: On the illuminated path near the second Paint Cage; check for the crystal.

Journal_Exp53.summary: After speaking to the Small Bourgeon, go west deeper into the cave; the journal is at the end.

Journal_Exp63.summary: From the Sanctuary Maze flag, take the west path downhill; the journal is near some corpses.

Journal_Exp52.summary: On the way to the arena, look left of the arena sign for a short side passage to the journal.

Journal_Exp66.summary: Late in the main quest, after Esquie knocks over a pillar, grapple across to the nearby abandoned camp.

Journal_Exp62.summary: On the world map directly north of Gestral Village; clear the rocks after completing Esquie’s Nest.

Journal_Exp38.summary: At Harvester's Hollow, head east and go up the slope; the journal is in the area surrounded by blue lamps.

Journal_Exp44.summary: From the slope leading to Expedition 38's journal, continue straight north to blue-lit Nevron corpses.

Journal_Exp59.summary: Near the Yellow Spire Wrecks checkpoint, head directly west; the journal is by a large hardened mass.

Journal_Exp78.summary: At the entrance, before fighting the Hexga, go the opposite way and climb the hidden rope to the upper area.

Journal_Exp56.summary: After the first cultists, follow the path ahead; the journal is at the base of a streetlight.

Journal_Exp50.summary: From the Paintress Shrine checkpoint, go north past the nearby Rocher; the journal is by discarded lamps.

Journal_Exp45.summary: After defeating the Giant Sapling, climb the rope behind it and take the side path on your left to the journal.

Journal_Exp64.summary: After unlocking Esquie’s swim ability in Act 2, swim south near The Meadows; the journal is by the canvas campground.

Journal_Exp54.summary: Behind the Chromatic Hexga boss; either defeat it or sprint behind it to grab the journal.

Journal_Exp41.summary: From Vanguard Point, climb down the cannon, go north to the Fading Woman, then take the east path into the trenches.

Journal_Exp57.summary: From Vanguard Point, go north past the Fading Woman, past the Paint Cage, then east; it's near the expeditioner with a trumpet head.

Journal_Exp48.summary: Head east on the world map from the Forgotten Battlefield to reach Stone Quarry; the journal is in this small area.

Journal_Exp65.summary: Near the eastern exit toward the snowy mountains, face the exit and look left for the journal by former Expeditioners.

Journal_Exp51.summary: After Monoco’s Station, enter Frozen Hearts, cross the tracks, and go behind the snow-covered train into the small cave.

Journal_Exp47.summary: Unverified: your scraper found no matching IGN description for this journal.

Journal_Exp58.summary: Found during a cutscene in Old Lumiere; unmissable.

Journal_OldLumiere.summary: On Left Street while playing as Maelle and Verso, go right onto the brick protrusion, jump into the hole, and open the door with the Old Key.

Journal_Exp42.summary: From Manor Gardens, take the east path, follow the light trail uphill, slide down the rope past the Paint Cage, and check the base of the golden blade.

Journal_RenoirManor.summary: After reentering Old Lumiere post-story, go forward from Manor Gardens, enter the broken Manor door, then check the bedroom nightstand.

Journal_Exp34.summary: In the optional area on the far northwestern world map, the journal is straight ahead from the entrance.

Journal_Exp35.summary: Before the bosses, right at the bridge; you can grab it without fighting them.

Journal_Exp49.summary: Speak with the Fading Boy, complete the Lady in Sap side quest, return when he moves, then go through the door; it's on your left after the stairs.

Journal_Exp36.summary: In this one-screen area west of the Act 1 mainland; the journal is in the crystal.

Journal_Exp43.summary: Once Esquie can swim through coral, go east of the Stone Wave Cliffs Cave; the journal is in the open near a tough enemy.

Journal_Exp55.summary: From the Dancing Classes checkpoint, go up the east stairs and look right for the glowing crystal.

Journal_Exp67.summary: From the Crumbling Path checkpoint, defeat Glissando, take the elevator behind it, and check directly across from where it lands.

Journal_RenoirVisages.summary: In Anger Vale, find the blue-lit cavern in the far west, go right at the fork, enter the door, then head south into the next room inside the manor.

Journal_Exp39.summary: In Sadness Vale, head to the far northwest and climb to the highest point; the journal is by a former Expedition camp.

Journal_Exp69.summary: In Joy Vale, head west from the flag, climb the slope, then look left for a small campground among fallen Expeditioners.

Journal_Exp40.summary: On the small island northeast of Visages while heading to the Monolith; it's near the Gestral Merchant.

Journal_Aline.summary: In Tainted Battlefield, turn left at the grave replica among the yellow trees, enter the Manor door, and check the center of the greenhouse.

Journal_Exp70.summary: From the tree in Tainted Lumiere, head west, grapple across two gaps, defeat the enemies, and check around the destroyed building.

Journal_Exp60.summary: In Act 3 outside the Opera House, go to the northwest ledge and fish the journal from the water.

Journal_Exp37.summary: After gaining flight, visit the eastern Gestral Beach and go directly right on arrival.

Journal_Exp46.summary: Raise Lune relationship to 5, visit after Act 3 starts, then go straight north and defeat the Chromatic Glissando; the journal is behind it.

Journal_Exp100B.summary: Once Esquie can fly, land on the ledge west of the Forgotten Battlefield; the journal is near the tents on your left.

Journal_Verso.summary: In the same area as Julie’s journal, go behind the tent and farther south by the destroyed building.

Journal_Exp84.summary: At the first fork in The Fountain, take the left path to the end; no combat is required.

Journal_RenoirSirene.summary: Get the Dessendre painting in The Canvas, place it on the blank canvas in The Manor, then enter the newly opened far north room.

Journal_RenoirReacher.summary: After the Ladder Area checkpoint, drop to the bottom, look west for the Manor door, and enter it.

Journal_Exp61.summary: As you continue climbing after the Foggy Area checkpoint, the journal is before the Peak checkpoint; use the balloon back down if needed.

Journal_Exp100A.summary: Defeat Simon in Renoir’s Drafts; the journal appears in the center of the arena.
